Rai / Helios team,

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. Attached is our latest redline of the MSA and a short annex with suggested language for publicity and customer attribution. Two quick asks to progress the order form: 

1) Please confirm whether Helios is comfortable with the proposed attribution block in section 7.2 (we included a narrow testimonial quote option and a logo-use opt-in with approval required).
2) If you prefer anonymity/aggregate phrasing instead of direct attribution, let us know which of the three alternate phrasings in the annex you prefer.

We've looped in Redwood Legal (Karthik) for a quick review of the Helios changes you flagged last week. If Helios legal can provide a small set of edits (or confirm green) by EOD Tuesday we can get the order form signed and schedule onboarding.

Subject: Re: MSA redlines — confidentiality + attribution (first pass)

Laura —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Overall the terminology looks fine, but legal at Helios prefers stricter confidentiality carveouts for pilot publications. They also asked for an explicit embargo window for public references (we suggest 90 days post-launch).

On attribution: we can approve logo use but only in the following form: 
- Helios Analytics (logo) + short case blurb approved by our comms team; no use of customer revenue numbers.

I’ve asked our legal team to send a short redline; expect that by tomorrow morning. If Redwood legal can confirm an acceptable escrow/approval workflow that would speed things up.

— Rai
Head of Partnerships, Helios Analytics
rai@helios.ai

Date: 2026-11-08T08:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MSA redlines — confidentiality + attribution (legal intake)

Laura / Neha —

Thanks for the context and attachments. Quick read highlights and questions from Legal: 

• Embargo window: 90 days is reasonable, but want to add language permitting earlier mutual consent.
• Logo use: we should require a separate "brand asset approval" step with a named Helios comms contact and a maximum two-business-day review period.
• Testimonial quotes: propose a 2-step approval (technical review by Helios product owner + comms sign-off) and a right to withdraw within 30 days in case of factual inaccuracies.

Can we get Helios to confirm the specific comms contact and whether they have a standard logo asset spec (SVG, color guidance)? Also, please attach the customer's redline when Helios Legal sends it — I'll provide inline comments.

If this is time-sensitive I can clear minor wording today; anything material I’ll escalate.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Legal — Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: Helios Legal <legal@helios.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Rai Patel <rai@helios.ai>
Date: 2026-11-08T09:19:00-08:00
Subject: RE: MSA redlines — confidentiality + attribution (Helios redline attached)

Laura / Redwood legal —

Please find our redline attached. High level: we accept logo use for marketing with the conditions below. Key asks: 

- Add explicit pilot-data exclusion in confidentiality (no public release of aggregated pilot metrics without mutual written consent).
- 90-day embargo from pilot completion, earlier only by mutual written agreement.
- Approval workflow: Helios comms (comm-approvals@helios.ai) must be named; we require 2 business days to review assets.
- Please add a clause requiring Redwood to provide draft copy for any case study 10 business days before publication.

Suggested contact for comms approvals: Maya Chen (maya.chen@helios.ai)

We attached Helios_MSA_Redline_v1.docx and a short evidence checklist (logo files, brand guide, approver contact).

Thanks,
Helios Legal
legal@helios.ai

Subject: Final — agreed publicity workflow & next steps (sign-off prep)

Team,

Thanks to Helios for the clear redline and to Karthik for the quick review. We have alignment on the following operational path to get the MSA and order form to signature: 

1) Publication/attribution: Helios agrees to logo use and a short case blurb. Redwood will provide drafts and brand assets to Maya Chen (maya.chen@helios.ai) for approval.
2) Embargo: 90 days post-pilot completion; earlier publication only by mutual written consent.
3) Approval SLAs: Helios comms 2 business days for asset sign-off; 10 business days for case study content review.
4) Evidence bundle required at signature: logo files (SVG/PNG), brand guide, named approver email, and a sample quote (if provided).

Action items: 
- Karthik: I think the legal wording you suggested for a 2-step testimonial approval + withdrawal right is ready; please prepare the final clause for insertion (target: EOD tomorrow).
- Neha: I'll update the order form to include the publicity annex and attach Helios' evidence checklist. Please also create a HubSpot reminder for the 10-business-day review. (HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4857)
- Marcus: hold the onboarding start date tentatively until signature + end of embargo window is recorded in the SOW.

If everyone agrees, I'll package the redline + annex and send to Helios for final sign-off and DocuSign.

Laura
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
